subject: general
question: What can be possible reason for the failure of 1857 revolt?

options.text: Superiority of British in terms of administration and religion.
The revolt did not spread to South India.

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 4**__ i.e __**All of the above**__.

 
• **Reasons for the failure of 1857 revolt**:

 
 
• The revolt didn't spread to South India and thus lacked all India character.
 
• Most of the rulers and zamindars were scared at the might of British rule and so didn't take part in the revolt.
 
• Lack of a unified plan and ideology.
 
• The British had sufficient resources both in terms of men and material.
 
• The British soldiers had superior arms and weapons.
 
• The British had access to an advanced system of communications and network in form of Railway, Post, and telegraph.
